cultural.vision_reason: Documentary field photo of a Anga market scene showing people in traditional dress, aprons and personal ornaments (lip-plugs, ear-plugs) with baskets of goods — consistent with daily/market life of the claimed group.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, scene of Plain Anga "market". Large group of male and female adults and children sitting and standing outdoors, amongst baskets of goods. Wearing aprons, personal-ornaments. Male standing in background wearing European shorts and hats, another wearing hat and tunic. Rural setting.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
